label: Aditi system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a two-component Aditi locus represented by DitA and DitB profiles that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Aditi branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual ditA or ditB genes, DitA or DitB proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Aditi locus, unresolved Aditi trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
